q8_ranges.rule: per circuit the log distance from the measured share to each prediction's range (0 inside it); published wins if the median over the group's circuits of (distance to generic - distance to published) > 0, generic otherwise; a verdict only if the group's median gap (generic lower end / published upper end) >= G, else indistinguishable; both rejected if the median distance to the winning range > log(band)
q8_ranges.rule_band_test_range: the range chosen in step (1), with or without a verdict (check 4, N4)
q8_ranges.G_frozen_note: the rule uses G_frozen (--q8-g-tm, --q8-g-act), set from the derivation on 17 November 2026 and fixed with k for the first run; G holds the derivation's own value at the chosen shots

ibm_qaoa_shots_q1_q2.floor_rule: raised only if ideal success >= 2.0 x a uniformly random guess's (n_ground / 2^n)

q2_shot_noise_power.law: counts Poisson, mean shots x (F' ideal + (1 - F') guess), F' = the check's retention

not_emulated.reason_recorded: no Goemans-Williamson seed state is stored above 20 variables, so the warm-start circuit of the method cannot be built; the model uses a placeholder seed (two-qubit structure identical)
